title: Vung Tau in a day
summary: Back Beach in the morning, bánh khọt on Nguyễn Trường Tộ, the Christ statue while the steps are still in shade, and Front Beach after dark. Skip the statue if the swim is the whole point.

days.title: One day on the peninsula
days.body: Swim on Back Beach, eat bánh khọt on Nguyễn Trường Tộ, and climb Christ the King if the steps are the plan. Front Beach is the walk after dark.

stops.name: Back Beach
stops.note: The morning. Swim where the waves are the flat ones. A clock for the walk is check on arrival.

approach.note: On the sand if you slept on the beachfront.

stops.name: Banh khot
stops.note: Nguyễn Trường Tộ. One cake at a time. The kitchen at number 14 is a location clue, not a pick.

approach.note: From the beach to Nguyễn Trường Tộ. Minutes are check on arrival.

stops.name: Christ the King
stops.note: About 800 steps to the feet and about 100 more. Or a motorbike taxi. Free on the Vietnam Tourism page. Not the Mary statue.

approach.note: The steps from the headland where Back Beach meets Pineapple Beach. Ride minutes, if you take the motorbike taxi, are check on arrival.

stops.name: Front Beach
stops.note: After dark. A drink along the arc. No bar is named. Swim was this morning, on Back Beach.

approach.note: From Small Mountain to the arc. Minutes are check on arrival.

seoTitle: Vung Tau in a day — beach, bánh khọt, statue
seoDescription: A one-day Vung Tau plan: Back Beach in the morning, bánh khọt, the Christ statue, and Front Beach after dark.
